# Terry McDonald

Terry McDonald is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Terry McDonald has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-mcdonald#e2)

  Not elected.
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-mcdonald#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 3 unopposed.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/terry-mcdonald/)

* * *

* * *

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Saviour No 3](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour-no-3) (1 seat), 15th October 2014.

**Terry McDonald was elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 3 in 2014 unopposed**.
